g.text: Dock v5 retrofit
The old post is drawn ghosted so the retrofit parts, pads and fasteners behind and inside it stay visible. Orange = parts you print now (R1), pale orange = tape.
R1 needs no cutting and no inserts. R2 is an option: one jigsaw cut, a new head, 4 inserts and 4 screws. Concept render from the current CAD.
Parts
dock post, printed earlier, unchanged (drawn ghosted so the parts behind it show)
2x cradle column, printed, mirror pair (R1)
2x tape strip 23.6 x 14.8 x 0.4, column to dock foot
2x stop pad D10 x 1.6, printed (R1)
2x tape disc D10 x 0.4, stop pad to wall face
T-gauge, flat alignment template, printed (R1)
sewing thread ~0.6 m, sight line pan axis through the 2 gauge holes
N52 magnet 6 x 3, in the floor land, 1 mm deep (holds the parked tool)
parked tool, for scale (GT1 body, neck in the slot)
option R2 head, printed (new slot: land 8, 1.0 mm/side, 4 mm lead-in chamfers)
4x M3 heat-set insert, 5.0 OD x 4 L, into the stump face (y = +-45, +-53, z = -33)
4x M3x10 button-head screw, head flange to stump
jigsaw cut: one straight cut at z = -24 removes the old wall top (R2 only)
Tape, thread and the R2 fasteners are drawn here; sizes nominal. Part details: docs/BOM.md. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
